silicon_melting_2.name: Melting of Silicon - Level 2
silicon_melting_2.description: Simulate the melting of Silicon by heating under NPT conditions using the Stillinger–Weber (SW) potential. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Monitor the Si–Si bond length using the partial radial distribution function (RDF) throughout the heating. Identify the phase change where the first RDF peak shows a significant change, defined as more than 10% increase from the initial value. Report the final average Si–Si bond length in the molten state in Å.
